All three compounds share a common target, the Raji cell line, suggesting a potential mechanism of action involving this kinase. The evidence points to a possible pathway where SB-269970 may modulate the activity of this kinase, leading to effects on Raji cells. The overlapping targets and the consistent association with Raji highlight a potential role for SB-269970 in influencing the kinase activity, possibly through a common mechanism that affects Raji cells. The integration of these findings suggests a plausible link between SB-269970 and Raji, supported by the shared target and the consistent association across different compounds.
